note: Investigated and fixed a real engine bug in src/engine/liveliness.ts: the auto-injector only re-animated `characters/*` entities, so any scene using a character-free register (ICON_TRIPLE, DIAGRAM, POLICY_LIST, HISTORY_TIMELINE) got ZERO periodic motion for its entire duration. Fixed to cover all non-connector-arrow entities (verified: emphasize events went 105->184, previously-dead scenes like v4-044 now get periodic pulse/bounce). Re-rendered and re-measured: visual-audit numbers were unchanged, because that audit measures per-frame pixel density/texture (edge density, saturation, frame-diff) on 5s-spaced samples, not motion frequency -- a brief small-icon pulse doesn't change the overall density of a frame that's mostly flat solid-colored background. Closing this gate would require richer/textured art assets or much more photographic content, in tension with this project's flat-cartoon identity and the V4.1 'photos are a sparing punch, not wallpaper' rule, or a recalibration of config/reference-quality.json's visualAudit thresholds. Per user decision (2026-07-27): keep the liveliness engine fix (it benefits all future videos), ship this video as-is with the visual-audit limitation documented rather than left silent.
